name: Discovery (STS-95)
about: Discovery (STS-95) (1998-064A), a crewed vehicle (OV-103), launched 1998 Oct 29. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1998 Oct 31), held fixed
GCAT names the site (KSC RW33); its coordinates are written from memory
